description:
THE PROJECT EXODUS Beyond Earth. Beyond Limits.

We are a team of curious minds passionate about space exploration, SpaceX, Planet X, science, and innovation. Driven by creativity, teamwork, and a desire to explore the unknown, we aim to turn bold ideas into reality.

We welcome enthusiastic members with skills in research, astronomy, engineering, coding, creative thinking, design, and communication.

One team. One mission. Infinite possibilities.
